inventory.rule: A pull request is credited when every commit in it is authored by Alex Ultra (alex-mextner). Pull request author may be alex-mextner or smoothbricker; the latter is recorded explicitly. A pull request that mixes in other authors is credited only for Ultra's named commits (attribution commit-scope, mixedAuthors true) or not at all. Automated mirror-sync pull requests are not counted. The pull request count is supporting information, not a complete contribution census.

excludedSummary.note: Pull requests that are not ours are counted only in aggregate. The per-pull-request audit is kept locally and is not published.
